name: Dragon Gym Summer Camp (Malvern)
street_address: 235 Lancaster Ave, Ste E-11 (Lincoln Ct Shopping Center)
description_short: Week-long martial arts day camp at Dragon Gym's Malvern school, open to beginners and kids who don't train there. Full day 8:00 to 4:00 for ages 6 to 13 and half day mornings or afternoons for ages 4 to 6.
refund_policy_summary: Full refund for any week cancelled by April 1, 2027. Payment plans for campers attending two or more weeks.
notes: Full day 8:00 to 4:00 (recommended ages 6 to 13, pack a lunch); half day 8:00 to 12:00 or 12:00 to 4:00 (recommended ages 4 to 6); early drop off at 7:00 on request. Kids can attend any Dragon Gym site; the same camp also runs in Berwyn and Exton. Prices are not posted on the camp page.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer camp page: 2027 registration open, Malvern weeks listed by date; full day ages 6 to 13, half day ages 4 to 6; early drop off at 7am; full day campers pack a lunch; full refund by April 1, 2027. Classes are on the mat in the school, so indoor. July 5, 2027 (Monday) holiday matches the 2027 calendar. No prices on the page. Address and phone of this school from the page footer.
